tables.label: Table 1
tables.caption: Characteristics of putative AMP sequences identified through bioinformatic analysis of bullfrog tadpole RNA-seq data.
footnotes: Each peptide sequence is separated into the prepro sequence and the presumed mature peptide sequence. Computational predictions of net charge, molecular weight (MW), and isoelectric point (pI) of the mature peptide are shown.

tables.label: Table 2
tables.caption: Comparison of sequence identities (%) of the AMP candidates with their best-known AMP blastp matches over the entire sequence (precursor) or by prepro or mature sequences.
footnotes: There was no AMP match with HP5.

tables.label: Table 3
tables.caption: Minimum inhibitory concentrations (MIC) and minimum bactericidal concentrations (MBC) in μM against M. smegmatis for tested known and putative AMPs from a minimum of five (MIC) and three (MBC) independent experiments.
footnotes: LL-37 is a human cathelicidin positive control and Tp0751 is a negative control peptide from T. pallidum. “−” No effect observed.
